messages:
lee (AE): Hey team — Zenya POC kickoff today. They need a hosted API key we can hand them that: 1) expires in 7 days, 2) is IP-allowlisted to their corp IPs, 3) limited to text-generation only (no embeddings), and 4) doesn't expose raw logs to external users. Can we provision that and note the rotation process?

sam (Solutions Eng): Yep we can do a scoped POC key. Recommend: create a project-scoped key with model allowlist (gpt-4o-mini, gpt-3.5-like), TTL 7d, rate limit 60rpm, and add their IPs to the allowlist. Also tag key with customer:zenya and poc:2026-03 to make cleanup easy.

anya (Security): Quick questions — does hosted POC key still write request metadata to audit logs? Zenya's security QA requires no request text stored for POC. If not possible, we should provide a pinned statement to SQA that data is not retained beyond standard retention window.

maria (Sales Eng): Zenya will sign a limited-data-sharing addendum if needed, but they'd prefer we disable request logging for that key. Sam — can we suppress request body logging for a scoped key?

sam (Solutions Eng): We have a "no-body-audit" flag for keys in the private plane but for hosted keys we can set redaction at ingestion. For this POC I can enable request-body redaction for that key (removes prompt text from logs) and keep metadata (latency, model, token counts). Will document in the SQA note.

anya (Security): That works if we document retention and provide proof. Also require that the key has an auto-rotate/revoke plan. We need a clear owner and a revoke timestamp.

lee (AE): Owner should be me for the POC, can you set revoke for 7d and add a slack alert to #sales when it's revoked?

infra-bot: Ticket created: INF-4521 — "zenya: create hosted POC key (7d ttl, IP allowlist, body-redaction)". Assignee: sam. ETA: 2026-03-22.

sam (Solutions Eng): I created the key skeleton in the console: api_key_id=pk_live_poc_zenya_1787 (provisional). Steps I'll take: 1) add IP allowlist (provided by Zenya), 2) set TTL=7d, 3) enable body-redaction, 4) limit to generation endpoints only, 5) tag and deploy.

maria (Sales Eng): Zenya provided two IP ranges: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.10/32. Sharing with you here, Sam.

sam (Solutions Eng): Got them. Also setting model allowlist to: ["redwood/gpt-4o-mini", "redwood/gpt-3.5-capable"]. For rotation: at T+6d we send a slack DM to lee with a rotation PIN and then revoke the old key at T+7d. Revocation process (for ops):

```
# revoke key
POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/api-keys/pk_live_poc_zenya_1787/revoke
Authorization: Bearer $INFRA_TOKEN
```

And to create a replacement key (if extended POC):

```
POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/api-keys
{ "project": "zenya-poc-2026-03", "ttl": "7d", "scopes": ["generation"], "allowlist": ["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.10/32"], "redact_body": true }
```

anya (Security): Please attach the audit export proving redaction and retention settings to the ticket. We'll sign the addendum once we see the logs.

sam (Solutions Eng): Will attach export. Also adding a note: for hosted keys we cannot guarantee zero transient storage during processing, but redaction removes prompt text from persisted logs. I'll draft the exact language for the addendum.

lee (AE): Thanks. Action items: sam to finish provisioning and attach audit export (INF-4521), anya to approve addendum language, maria to confirm IPs with Zenya and relay PO if they want extension. I'll monitor.

infra-bot: INF-4521 status updated: provisioning complete. Key id=pk_live_poc_zenya_1787 created, expires 2026-03-29T15:00:00Z.

maria (Sales Eng): Confirmed with Zenya — they accepted body-redaction and 7-day window. We may need a follow-up if they extend to dedicated later.

lee (AE): Closing loop — once we hit T+6d I'll coordinate rotation. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
